notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Small update to let you know that In The Shadows 1.1.1.1060 build is now live and fixes the following two issues:

- Mapping issues with keyboard/gamepad, not detected properly/forgotten on restart
- X and B button tool-tips for Xbox360/XboxOne controller were inverted in menus

If you have any issues with the game, feel free to comment!

- Nicolas

notes.title: Release moved to October 13
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Just a quick note to let you all know, In The Shadows won't be ready until October 13. I had some things that I had to deal with and was forced to push back the date a little bit.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26720245/c07e74d4ae29559cbbebde20c671f398c153c5b6.png[/img]

You can read more about it on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/6502b/in-the-shadows-1/posts/1995917] Kickstarter [/url] update page

Thank you for your patience! 

Nicolas

notes.title: April Update : Kickstarter Backers Beta!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

In The Shadows is now officially in beta and testing has started with the Kickstarter barkers who pledged in the "Beta tier". I'm getting closer to the release and this testing will help find bugs, make the game better.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26720245/0291fe9fb748c9d644c97f918b249ac3914fee63.png[/img]

You can read more about this update [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/6502b/in-the-shadows-1/posts/1871602] on the Kickstarter post![/url]

Stay tunned for more updates!
